1.title: Trump’s Push for AI Data Center Expansion Puts Some Republican Lawmakers in a Bind
1.summary: Several Republicans in close races have distanced themselves from President Trump’s effort to speed the construction of A.I. data centers, citing concerns about rising electricity bills.

2.title: Clancy Returns to Court as Lawyers Seek Investigation of Holdout Juror
2.summary: Lawyers representing Lindsay Clancy have also asked a judge to find her not guilty, saying insufficient evidence was presented at her murder trial, which ended in a mistrial this month.

3.title: A Tough Ad Reminds Nebraska Voters About a Brutal Crime and a Pardon
3.summary: A group supporting Dan Osborn, the independent Senate candidate in Nebraska, is airing an ad attacking Senator Pete Ricketts, a Republican, for pardoning a man convicted of sexual assault.

4.title: Prime Minister Andy Burnham Lays Out Plan to Change UK in Emotional Speech at Labour Conference
4.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham outlined his proposals for major policy changes and said: “I accept people will not agree with every part of it.”

5.title: Israeli Settlers Stop Soldiers From Returning Palestinians to Their Home
5.summary: The Supreme Court had ordered the military to ensure a West Bank family that fled violence could go back. But settlers blocked the effort, with the authorities accused of not doing enough to stop them.

6.title: Evicted Woman Set to Return Home as Spain Announces Plans to Fix Housing Crisis
6.summary: The eviction of an 87-year-old set off protests in the country, which has an acute housing shortage. The government presented legislation to protect renters.
